sample_unit: caregiver-style pediatric questions (each posed to 4 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to pediatric caregiver questions versus health-literacy targets
links.effect: None of the models consistently met health-literacy targets (approx. 6th-8th grade); Grok often college level, while DeepSeek and Gemini were simpler and more concise.
links.quote: None of the models consistently met health-literacy targets for patient materials (approximately 6th-8th grade reading level).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses to caregiver pediatric prompts scored by pediatricians and readability metrics; does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
